architectural-decision-records.why: records the invoke schema decision and its injection/fail-closed reasoning
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0059: gates may declare invoke (CLI args) so arg-based engineering gates can travel; fail-closed on malformed, no shell
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the change ships discriminating tests for the new arg-passing
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added an aggregator test where the gate passes only if it received its invoke arg (and fails without it), plus malformed-invoke fail-closed, plus a schema test rejecting non-string invoke
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds aggregator + schema logic, so the levels are explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: unit tests at the aggregator (real spawn) and the schema-contract (validator) levels; the right levels for a runner + a schema change
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the changed aggregator; behavior pinned as scenarios
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: implements invoke-arg passing with discriminating scenarios for delivered/absent/malformed
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the aggregator now passes args to a spawned process
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: invoke args go through spawnSync with NO shell (no command injection), and a malformed invoke fails closed rather than silently dropping args and scanning nothing; the manifest is parity/provenance-protected so the args are trusted content
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the limit rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that invoke is a STATIC arg list; a gate needing a runtime value (a changed-file list) still needs workflow wiring, not the manifest
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran a fresh-context judge-arch over the schema change, the aggregator invoke handling, the tests, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

release-deployment-safety.why: a schema + runner change; nothing deployed, migrated, or released

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a manifest field + arg passing; no system/data architecture change

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or migration

arch-encode.why: a schema addition, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
